title: Golf club heads, cast in Vietnam, finished in China
description: Titanium and stainless-steel heads are cast and shaped in Vietnam, then welded, machined and coated in China. CBP held Vietnam (N346303): the casting decides.
notes: One of the six families added in D660 (golf clubs and sporting goods). Built from CBP's facts into a development fixture; plant capabilities, duty rates, import value and group costs are illustrative placeholders, not sourced. The ruling itself is excluded from precedent search. Picked by family, not by result. Recorded development run (eval/results/plan-golf-driver-heads-2025-local-verifier-v2-d660-litellm.json): the engine agreed with CBP on Vietnam at 0.90 stated. The shown plan moves the club heads to China, check 0.97 on N340536; that ruling held Vietnam for putter heads formed there and finished in China, so it supports the forming country deciding. A run on this site is a new run and may differ.
